up: List all approved drugs indicated for chronic kidney disease. For each drug, include the ChEMBL ID, name, canonical SMILES, EFO ID, indication label, and max phase for that indication.
sql:
WITH ckd_indications AS (
  SELECT
    di.molregno,
    di.mesh_heading AS indication_label,
    di.efo_id,
    di.max_phase_for_ind
  FROM drug_indication di
  WHERE di.mesh_heading LIKE '%chronic kidney disease%'
), ckd_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    md.molregno,
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name
  FROM ckd_indications di
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON di.molregno = md.molregno
  WHERE md.max_phase = 4
)
SELECT
  cd.chembl_id,
  cd.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  ci.efo_id,
  ci.indication_label,
  ci.max_phase_for_ind
FROM ckd_drugs cd
JOIN ckd_indications ci ON cd.molregno = ci.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cd.molregno = cs.molregno;
